question: Can I still edit invoice INV-0007? Its status says final and it has not been paid.
note: This one has regressed more than once. `doc_status` DEFAULTS to 'final', so the column says 'final' about an invoice nobody finalised - editability is not inferable from it. An unpaid invoice is editable. The question states the trap out loud so a wrong answer is a wrong answer rather than a guess. It is the one vocabulary case that also reads a record, so it is the case that proves the two blocks stay apart: the invoice row is [1] and citable, the two term files are prefixed above it with no number at all.
